It refers to the use of a discharge plate due to a nighttime dental clenching habit. What is your diagnosis?

Options:

opc. Mandibular condyle fracture.
opd. Fibrous ankylosis of the temporomandibular joint.
ope. Bony ankylosis of the temporomandibular joint.
